item.title: Gemini 4 Neon
item.description:
📝 Introducing Gemini 4 Neon Nov 18, 2026 | x. For production-ready code, Neon handles multi-file debugging and refactoring across repositories with targeted, surgical edits. item.title: Multiple vulnerabilities in Regexp and String case conversion
item.description:
📝 Compiling a crafted regular expression pattern may allow remote code execution in applications that compile attacker-controlled patterns. GHSA-wpqw-5qxg-m68r: Out-of-bounds read in case-insensitive regular expression matching Ruby has an out-of-bounds read in its regular expression engine. GHSA-3p8q-wmhx-vm2w: Heap buffer overflow in regular expression compilation Ruby has an integer overflow in its regular expression engine, which causes a heap-based buffer overflow.
🔗 Read more: https://www.ruby-lang.org/en/news/2026/11/18/multiple-vulnerabilities-in-regexp-and-string/
